successful_patterns.pattern: Transfer from the behavioral_full set works: 34/40 of its best constructs re-expressed in canonical OHLCV+VWAP+AMOUNT clear the 0.03 gates
successful_patterns.evidence: cR1: every champion survives — hl_med60 0.094 OOS, max20 0.091, gapvol 0.085, aggrmax 0.083, ret_on_hivol60 (volume-conditioned) 0.082, semivol120 0.079, volclock 0.076. Conditional and masked-asym constructs translate with VOLUME conditions.

successful_patterns.pattern: Novel canonical-only constructs mint beyond transfer: nvol conditionals/asymmetries, 120d tiers, robust medians
successful_patterns.evidence: cR2: id_on_hivol120 OOS 0.081, hl_updown60 0.070, attn_up_cnt120 0.065, ret_hl_corr120 0.063, aggr_min60 0.063, gapmed120, signed_nvol both bands, nvol_burst both bands. The volume-normalized (nvol) framing supports the whole conditional/asym/event portfolio even though RegBeta on it is dead.

successful_patterns.pattern: Main-set band-coexistence patterns replicate: semivol60, min60, aggrmax60, aggr_updown 20/60, hl bursts, gapmed20 all clear next to siblings; gap-crash magnitude is new
successful_patterns.evidence: cR3: min_gap60 (quarterly deepest gap-down) OOS -0.064 — a construct the main set never accepted (20d version died there); nvol_spike 0.052 (turn_spike analog), lag2 both bands in.

successful_patterns.pattern: Conditional RANGE is a novel first-class construct: range on high-attention days
successful_patterns.evidence: cR4: hl_on_hivol 0.078 / hl_on_hivol60 0.081 OOS — passed despite hlmed60 resident (conditional masking decorrelates from the level); semivol250 and id_on_hivol250 extend the 250d tier.

successful_patterns.pattern: Conditional returns on wide-RANGE days is the set's best factor; aggression asymmetry completes to 120d
successful_patterns.evidence: cR5: ret_on_hiHL120 OOS 0.0921 (set-wide best); aggr_updown120 0.052. The condition variable matters: RANGE-conditioned returns beat VOLUME-conditioned (0.092 vs 0.081).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: RegBeta elasticity constructs on self-normalized volume (nvol = VOLUME/TsMean) — the free-float normalization of turnover was load-bearing
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR1: c_elasticity ICIR 0.03, c_fragility -0.07 (as turnover versions: 0.83 and 0.65). Correlation-style couplings survive self-normalization; regression betas do not. Also c_ret_nvol_corr deduped into c_vol_updown (0.7+), c_ovnshare OOS 0.018, c_vwapdev 2/3 universes, c_volterm IC 0.027 under the modern bar.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: nvol couplings with RANGE/GAP/AGGRESSION partners die at S1 (unlike TURN versions in the main set); candle event-framing doesn't rescue the family
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR2: hl_nvol_corr 0.34/IC 0.019, gap_nvol_corr 0.41/0.022, aggr_nvol_corr 0.42/0.024 — all ICIR-viable but IC under 0.03 (turnover carried more cross-sectional information than self-normalized volume for these); reject_freq 0.08; gap_hl_corr -0.09. S2/S3: hlmed20~hlmed60 0.85, ret_namt~ret_nvol-family 0.76, ret_on_hivol120 dup of id_on_hivol120.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Longer-band rescues that DON'T work: meanmed 60/120 (IC<0.03), idmed120, hlterm_slow, hl_nvol_corr even at 120d, ret_on_lovol120, upday-share ratios; 250d-adjacent and max120/rev120/gapvol60 die at S2 vs their siblings
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR3 S1: meanmed60 0.027, meanmed120 0.025, hl_nvol_corr120 IC 0.015 (the range-attention coupling is dead at every band in canonical vocab). S2: max120~max60-family 0.72, rev120~rev-family 0.70, gapvol60~gapvol 0.74, nvolmax~volcv 0.70, illiq_term~zeroret -0.87. S4: pvcorr60 OOS 0.019, gap_on_hivol120 0.013 (gap conditionals dead at all tiers).

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Robust-deviation class (X vs own median) under the bar; gap asymmetry dead at every band; candle constructs closed in all framings
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR4 S1: hl_med_dev 0.026, nvol_med_dev 0.021, gap_updown60 0.010, close_pos_med 0.012, range_stud -0.021. Near-misses for jitter retries: ovnmom20 0.028, vwap_gap_med 0.032/0.29, aggr_sum60 0.028, updn_freq_hl 0.027/0.30.

forbidden_patterns.pattern: Conditional-on-attention variants mostly collide with residents now (6 S2 kills at 0.71-0.85); quiet-day complements and drought/efficiency probes dead
forbidden_patterns.evidence: cR5: hl_on_down~hlmed60 0.76, max_on_hivol~max20 0.85, id_on_hiHL60~rev20 0.84, gapvol_on_hivol~gapvol 0.71; hl_on_lovol 0.08, nvol_min -0.10, travel_eff 0.06 at S1; wma_cross and ret_asym_cnt both at ICIR 0.30 borderline again; hl_cv OOS 0.023, att_autocorr 0.028 (S4 near-misses -> 120d/60d jitter retries).
